title: Manila Water completes East Bay Ph 2 transmission lines amid El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As it continues to strengthen its water supply system in view of the looming strong El Niño up to next year, Manila Water has completed the 1,200-millimeter (mm) diameter submarine transmission lines for the East Bay Phase 2 project. The milestone enhances Manila Water’s capability to convey additional water across the East Bay
